goal: Hang all three mugs by their handles on the mug rack (cup_holder), then bring both arms back to where they started.
instruction_templates: Hang all the mugs on the mug rack.
success: For each mug m in {mug0, mug1, mug2} (all three, simultaneously):
- lifted: m's current origin z is more than 0.045 m above its origin z at episode start (is_lift, z_threshold=0.045; current height, not 'ever lifted').
- m's 'handle' active functional point has world z > 0.9 m (any handle point; is_A_functional_point_higher_than_z, z=0.9).

- m's 'handle' active functional-point frame z-axis is within 60 deg of the z-axis of the cup_holder's 'handle_support_point' passive functional-point frame. Both frames are the FIRST functional point of that tag (RoboDojo's is_axis_aligned takes element [0] of each list): the mug's first 'handle' point and the rack's first 'handle_support_point', whichever hook the mug actually hangs on.
- m's handle frame x-axis is within 60 deg of the cup_holder handle_support_point frame's +x OR -x axis (either sign accepted; again the first handle point and the rack's first support point).

- m's 'handle' active functional point is within 0.045 m (3-D Euclidean) of a cup_holder 'handle_support_point' passive functional point (is_A_functional_point_close_to_B_functional_point, threshold=0.045, no orientation-alignment option).

all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, at the same action boundary as all other conditions. Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
evaluation: All listed conditions are checked together, in order, after every action (reward_manager.step runs once per action, after the action's whole control sequence has executed; nothing is checked between actions). They form a single stage: all must be true at the same action boundary (any list inside the conditions means 'at least one of'). Success is declared at the first action boundary where all hold; the episode then ends. No final_check list is used. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim actions. Conditions are not required to be held for any duration; one action boundary where everything is true is enough. Nothing makes the episode fail early (no queries).
objects: mug0, mug1, mug2: mugs (category 'mug', model indices 0-9, sampled with duplicates allowed), 3 total, start on the table in x in [-0.45,0.45], y in [-0.25,0.02] (table frame) with random yaw 15-165 deg, margin 0.05
cup_holder: the mug rack (category cup_holder, index 0), static geometry, 1, x in [-0.20,0.20], y in [0.0,0.05] (table frame), yaw up to +-25 deg
needs_memory_or_language: none (single fixed instruction; mug/rack identity is visible).
end_requirements: all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, (part of the success condition). Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
notes: The success test does not name which hook each mug goes on, and the check is per mug against ANY handle_support_point of the rack, so assignment of mugs to hooks is free (physically they cannot share one). 'handle' and 'handle_support_point' are asset-defined functional points whose exact positions/frames cannot be read statically. Intermediate partial-credit get_score (transition 15/40/100 for 1/2/3 mugs hung with grippers open) is not part of success. Predicate conventions (from func_parser.py): object 'position' = the object's root/origin position in world coordinates (metres, z up); 'bbox' = the 8 corners of the object's local bounding box transformed to world; is_A_in_B = A's origin xy lies inside the convex hull of B's world-projected bbox AND A's origin z > B's bbox z_min; is_axis_up(label, axis, threshold) = angle between (object rotation applied to the local axis) and world +z is < threshold degrees (wrapper default threshold 15 deg); is_axis_aligned = angle between two (optionally functional-point-frame) axes < align_threshold degrees, optionally after projection onto a plane (project_plane='xy' drops z and renormalises); all_robot_back_to_origin() default = for every target (agent-controlled) arm, end-effector pose vs its pose at episode start: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation difference <= 20 deg; is_all_gripper_open(open_threshold) = every target gripper's normalised opening ((val-scale0)/(scale1-scale0)) >= open_threshold (wrapper default 0.6).
